title: The mosaic workshop was...
text: The mosaic workshop was in the Gothic quarter and easy to get to. The instructor gave a brief introduction showing the difference between Mosaic and trencadís and how to safely cut the tiles and assemble them onto our board. It was really easy to pick up and complete in about an hour. The activity was very relaxing, especially under jet lag from the flight the night before. Pick up time was flexible and you could pick up as soon as later that afternoon in the next day. The grout makes the colors of the tile looks so bright! title: Mosaic Delight!
text:
This was such a great experience and I’m so glad my friends and I did it. 
After traveling through Spain for 2 weeks and seeing all the beautiful mosaics it was inspiring to do one myself! 
The staff were amazing as well! So helpful and friendly. 
Highly recommend this.
